text:
alex: kicking off observability commissioning sweep for the new eu-central-2 GPU cluster. scope: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerting templates. need owners and a short validation plan.

maria: I can own the logging pipeline. plan is fluent-bit -> loki (chunked), 14d retention by default, with a sampling rule for debug logs. anyone with objections? :eyes:

simon: I'll take metrics & prometheus. I'll deploy prometheus-operator, set scrape intervals, and push a set of recording rules for GPU metrics and pod-level latency percentiles.

jamie: dashboard work here. I'll adapt the existing gpu-node-overview and model-serving-latency dashboards and make a lightweight team-facing dashboard for SLOs. will publish Grafana IDs once created.

tara: alert templates from me. core alerts: HighGPUUtilization (>90% 5m), GPUMemoryPressure, PodOOMRisk (eviction threshold), PrometheusTargetDown, LokiIngestionLatency. I'll post YAML snippets.

alex: network constraints: this cluster is in a restricted subnet with no outbound internet. we need VPC endpoints for S3 (loki), ECR, and access to our internal prom/thanos endpoints. ops-bot, can you confirm endpoint playbook?

ops-bot: endpoint-check triggered for eu-central-2. Required endpoints: s3, sts, ecr, kms, cloudwatch-logs (for optional forwarder). Report will follow in 10m.

maria: note on cost: expected log ingest ~3GB/day based on estimated qps, but model-serving debug logs could spike. proposal: sample 60% of logs at edge for 72h after rollout, then re-evaluate. also enable compression in fluent-bit.

simon: scrape plan: node-exporter 15s, kube-state-metrics 30s, app metrics 30s. recording rules: gpu:util:avg5m, gpu:mem:used:ratio, pod:request_latency:95. I'll attach examples.

jamie: quick smoke commands for validation (run from jump host):
```
kubectl get pods -n observability -o wide
kubectl -n observability logs -l app=loki --tail=100
curl -sS http://prometheus.eu-central-2.internal/api/v1/targets | jq '.data.activeTargets | length'
```

tara: alert rule sample (PrometheusRule):
```
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: redwood-gpu-alerts
spec:
  groups:
  - name: gpu.rules
    rules:
    - alert: HighGPUUtilization
      expr: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[5m]) > 0.9
      for: 5m
      labels:
        severity: page
      annotations:
        summary: "GPU utilization > 90% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```

alex: good. validation checklist proposal (short):
- infra: VPC endpoints exist, routes ok, security groups for metrics/logs allowed
- logging: fluent-bit pods healthy, Loki push success rate > 99% for 10m
- metrics: Prometheus targets up, recording rules firing, TSDB head health OK
- dashboards: 3 dashboards created (node, serving, team-slo) with links
- alerts: template rules applied and a test alert fired then resolved
- cost: 14d retention, sampling applied, expected monthly delta < $Xk

maria: I'll run the logging smoke and report back with ingestion numbers. ETA 30m.

simon: deploying prometheus-operator now to the observability namespace. will attach recording rule PR in ~45m.

jamie: creating dashboards now; will push to team org and tag with "eu-central-2-commissioning".

ops-bot: deploy:prometheus-operator started by simon at 1714829800

oncall: acknowledged. I'll run the final preflight at 1714832400 and mark green/red. ping me when all alerts are applied.

alex: thanks all. please keep this thread for short status updates. plan to hand over runbook and a single-page observability checklist to SRE after validation. :rocket:
